0 2 · Just Completed·Flat tile · no ridge caps

We just built one.

The same idea as the Siesta Key house, finished by our own crews.

On this home every hip and ridge was built without a cap. The tile courses run all the way up and meet at each line, so the roof keeps its crisp, layered edge right to the top.

Each line is still fully closed and sealed. The craft is in doing that without a single heavy piece of trim showing, and on a roof this clean every line has to be exactly right, because every line shows.

The design brings tile, metal and flat roofing together across a long, many-winged house. It is one of the most distinctive tile roofs we have ever built, and it is the closest thing we know to the roof you have in mind.

The roof is tile but built with no cap at the ridges for a clean elegant look.Your architect, describing the roof you want. It describes this one too.
